fundWithdrawal.pageDescription: Submit and view your withdrawal requests. Funds are debited only after finance approves.
fundWithdrawal.approvalPageDescription: Review user withdrawal requests. Approval uploads a payment screenshot and debits the applicant's account.
fundWithdrawal.approvalDetailDescription: Verify the request and payment screenshot, then approve or reject. Approval debits the applicant's account and creates a fund batch.

approvalDetail.invalidLinkDescription: The link is missing a request id. Open this page from the approval list.
approvalDetail.notFound: Withdrawal request not found or not visible to you
approvalDetail.loadFailed: Failed to load the withdrawal request
approvalDetail.noPermission: You do not have withdrawal review permission
approvalDetail.rejectHint: Rejection does not debit funds. The applicant is notified with the reason.
approvalDetail.alreadyHandled: This request has been handled and cannot be reviewed again.
approvalDetail.staleHint: The request was handled by another reviewer or its data changed. Refresh to recheck before continuing.
approvalDetail.leaveBlocked: The review is being submitted. Wait for the result before leaving.

approve.title: Approve withdrawal
approve.proofHint: jpg, png, or webp up to 10 MiB. The uploaded name becomes “display name-withdrawal amount-date”.
approve.negativeHint: Fund accounts may have a negative balance. The requested amount is debited on approval.

toast.submitted: Withdrawal request submitted for finance review

apply.unavailable: No fund account has been opened. Contact finance.

error.account: Failed to load the fund account
error.submit: Failed to submit the withdrawal request
error.proof: Failed to load the payment screenshot

empty.ownHint: Your submitted requests will appear here
